# The Station

## Chapter I. The Train

On March 5, 1984, Mr. Smith waited at the station for the 7:30 a.m. train. The ticket cost $5.20, and he had bought it on the 21st of February.

“Is this the train to Bath?” he asked.

“It is,” said the guard, “but it is late again.”

Mrs. Bennet read about Henry VIII while the 12 carriages rolled in, one by one.
